dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd only call myself the normal kind of awesome...

dialogues.speaker: Rufina
dialogues.text: She said that you didn't just save her, but the bad guys even had to kneel and beg you for mercy... You're just like The Great Adventurer Stanley!

dialogues.speaker: Rufina
dialogues.text: I wanna be like him— No, I wanna be like you! I'm gonna be an awesome adventurer, too!
